posts.name: YamiFreighter
posts.cooked:
I Asked ChatGPT about the meaning of the word Pouchven. After I got a sufficient response that tells me it does indeed know what I am talking about I asked it about the names of the triglavian ships.

Currently there are four triglavian ships players do not have access to.
Koliada - Seems like a triglavian variant of a Venture based on where it’s seen.
Potremba - Seems like a hauler or mining barge. Possibly both.
Stribozha - A Tanker version of the above ship. Similar roles. Possibly even a triglavian version of the Orca.
Xordazh - World ark, speculated to be similar to our current titans.

THEN I went one step further. I asked it what future Triglavian ship names CCP might give to future ships. It gave me three.

Miroslav - This name combines elements of Slavic names. “Miro” means “peace” or “world,” while “slav” is a common element in Slavic names meaning “glory” or “fame.” The combination could represent a ship that brings its own form of influence and impact to the game’s universe, in line with the enigmatic nature of the Triglavians.

This Might possibly be a FAX?

Perunov - This name draws inspiration from the Slavic god Perun, who is associated with thunder, lightning, war, and protection. The suffix “-ov” is a common ending in Slavic surnames, indicating “belonging to” or “descendant of.” The name “Perunov” could evoke a sense of power, protection, and authority, fitting for a ship within the Triglavian Collective’s fleet.

Command ship? This might end up being the name of the T2 Drekavak

Morozhna - This name takes inspiration from the Russian word “мороз” (moroz), which means “frost” or “cold.” The “-na” suffix could indicate association or belonging. “Morozhna” could evoke an icy or chilling presence, in line with the mysterious and otherworldly nature of the Triglavian Collective.

This feels like the name of an Ewar ship. But considering the nature of Triglavian ships already having this capability as their role bonus. I wouldn’t speculate too much into that. I honestly have no idea where this one even could go.
EDIT: Triglavian dictor/HIC.
